stableBaseline.name: clean-router-promoted-no-status-plus-locked-overlays
stableBaseline.note: This file does not enforce runtime behavior. It documents the current clean /cloud owner split before any future registry checker or bind enforcement.

purpose: Make the existing no blind binding / object information card rule machine-readable.
Keep a narrow shadow map before binding code starts enforcing owners.
Avoid reintroducing the old lapFinal / leavingCoffeeCorner / console-hot-restore mixed patch chain.
Record base-image locked decorative overlays so future checker work can detect overlay drift or selector reuse.

enforcement.nextSafeStep: read-only checker under a test parameter only, if ever needed
enforcement.doNotDoYet: Do not block clicks or replace existing handlers from this registry until the read-only checker passes on real /cloud and screen-home PWA.

rules: Does not own decorative overlay coordinates except scene show/hide state.
Do not revive the full old console-hot-restore.js bundle just to fix console.
Refresh restores current line but must not advance the queue.
Only user hotspot action may advance the queue.
Scene router must not show/hide/advance bubble directly.
Do not replace this with viewport CSS nudges or a global overlay repaint guard.
It may stay visually suppressed by polish CSS, but its identity and coordinate remain registered.
Must not be replaced by a global repaint guard.
The home notebook art hotspot belongs to the home scene in the current art.
It must not open from coffeeCorner unless a future coffeeCorner art object is explicitly approved.

antiPatterns: one script owning router + bubble + steam + console + clock together
reviving full console-hot-restore.js as a general fix
global overlay repaint guard that touches home and coffeeCorner together
viewport CSS nudge as canonical coordinate for art-locked overlay
promotionPlan: 1. Keep this file as shadow documentation first.
2. If needed later, add a read-only registry checker under a test-only query parameter.
3. Compare checker results against data/object-registry.v1.json and this shadow map.
4. Only after read-only checks pass, make future binders consult the registry before adding handlers.
5. Do not enforce owner blocking on current /cloud in the same step as registry wiring.
